description: Create a scheduled event. For 'VOICE'/'STAGE_INSTANCE' events provide channel_id; for 'EXTERNAL' events provide location AND scheduled_end_time. Requires the Manage Events permission. Returns the new event's name and ID.

channel_id.description: Voice or stage channel ID (snowflake). Required for VOICE/STAGE_INSTANCE events.

entity_type.description: Where the event happens: 'VOICE' or 'STAGE_INSTANCE' (needs channel_id), or 'EXTERNAL' (needs location + scheduled_end_time).

location.description: Free-text location (e.g. a URL or place). Required for EXTERNAL events.

scheduled_end_time.description: Event end as an ISO 8601 datetime. Required for EXTERNAL events.

scheduled_start_time.description: Event start as an ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. '2026-06-01T20:00:00Z'. Must be in the future.

name: discord_create_scheduled_event
